name: django-machina-5ecfad38-blind20-ots
instr:
# django-machina: twenty behavioural regressions across forums, permissions, polls and tracking — without a test suite

I have been running a forum built on this package after picking up a recent build, and a lot of it is behaving oddly. Below is everything I have been able to pin down by observation. The repository has received 20 separate undocumented edits.

## Forum listings and visibility

Filtering a set of forums down to the ones a given user is allowed to see is broken outright. Any page that renders a single forum fails to come up at all, the "mark forums read" and "mark this forum's topics read" actions fail, and asking directly for the visible subset of a forum queryset does not produce a usable answer — neither for a forum that should be visible nor for one that should be hidden because it, or an ancestor, is not visible to the user.

The recursive rendering of a forum tree through the template layer also no longer matches what the same forum-list template produces when rendered directly; feeding a visibility tree through the tag gives different (or no) output.

## Permission resolution

Permissions granted to a user globally, i.e. not attached to any particular forum, are no longer honoured when checking that user against a forum. Precedence is wrong too: where an individual user grant or denial should win over what their group says, the answer comes out wrong — in both directions (allowed-by-group/denied-for-user and denied-by-group/allowed-for-user), at global
